q.en: In a word processor, the page orientation in which the page is wider than it is tall is called what?
q.as: ৱৰ্ড প্ৰচেছৰত, পৃষ্ঠা উচ্চতাতকৈ বহল হোৱা পৃষ্ঠা অভিমুখীকৰণক কি বোলা হয়?

explanation.en: Landscape orientation makes the page wider than it is tall.
explanation.as: লেণ্ডস্কেপ অভিমুখীকৰণে পৃষ্ঠাক উচ্চতাতকৈ বহল কৰে।
